title: Means Inventory
description: Portfolio-level means inventory (`<portfolio>/means.json` — effectuation bird-in-hand, chief-wiggum#235 amendment). Honest skill levels are load-bearing inputs, not vanity fields: the bet-selection lint reads sales/marketing here — while both are novice and no channel has ever reached `focused`, a bet whose acquisition plan has no ecosystem channel and no owned audience is flagged (report-only). A bet proposal must reference the means it draws on (bet.json means_refs). Absent means.json → dependent checks report `skipped`, never crash.

skills.description: Skill → honest self-assessed level. Keys are free-form ('sales', 'marketing', 'engineering', ...); the bet-selection lint reads 'sales' and 'marketing'.

assets.description: Things owned that a bet can draw on (codebases, infra, tooling, cash-adjacent assets).

network.description: Who you know — reachable people/communities a bet's distribution can lean on.

owned_audience.description: Audiences already owned (lists, followings, communities) — the bet-selection lint accepts a plan that draws on one.

hours_per_week.description: Total operator hours/week available — the numerator in the capacity-based cap (chief-wiggum#274, §9.6.3): remaining capacity = hours_per_week − Σ(measured ongoing load of every live/lifestyle bet) − reserve_hours_per_week.

reserve_hours_per_week.description: Hours/week held back from the capacity-based cap's arithmetic for factory ops, marketing on the current bet, or anything else not itself a bet (chief-wiggum#274). Absent → 0.

cash_available.description: Current zero-based slack, USD — the ability side of affordable loss. Envelopes justified by projected future revenue are the business analogue of building on an UNRESOLVED: fact.

contracting_rate_usd_per_hour.description: The operator's contracting/day rate, expressed hourly, USD — the counterfactual for the opportunity-cost benchmark (chief-wiggum#275, docs/business-factory.md §9.6.5 screen 13): every low-cap bet is judged against this rate for the same hours, never against zero and never against venture outcomes. Absent → the benchmark is unresolved (report-only, never guessed).
